tasks.title: Conversation #116
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Are you all set for the conference next week?
Man: Almost. I just booked my flight this morning, so that's one thing off the list.
Woman: That's great. Did you already register for the conference itself?
Man: Not yet. I was waiting to confirm my travel plans first. I'll take care of the registration this afternoon. Hopefully, there are still spots left for the breakout sessions.
Woman: If you want, I can forward you the link I used to register. It also has a list of the sessions that still have space.
Man: That would be really helpful. Thanks.

questions.stem: What has the man already done to prepare for a conference?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士已经为会议做了哪项准备工作？ 定位原文：Man: I just booked my flight this morning, so that's one thing off the list. 选项分析： A. Registered for breakout sessions 注册了分组讨论。男士说还没注册（Not yet），所以A选项错误。 B. Booked his hotel 预订了酒店。对话中未提及酒店预订，所以B选项错误。 C. Reserved a flight 预订了航班。男士明确说“booked my flight”，所以C选项正确。 D. Created a presentation 制作了演示文稿。对话中未提及演示文稿，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman offer to do?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士主动提出要做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: If you want, I can forward you the link I used to register. It also has a list of the sessions that still have space. 选项分析： A. Help him book a hotel 帮他预订酒店。对话中未提及酒店，所以A选项错误。 B. Send him some conference information 发给他一些会议信息。女士要转发注册链接以及还有名额的分组讨论列表，这些都属于会议信息，所以B选项正确。 C. Register him for a conference 帮他注册会议。女士只是转发注册链接，并没有说代他注册，所以C选项错误。 D. Reserve some meeting space 预订一些会议场地。对话中未提及预订场地，所以D选项错误。
